hash: md5; idx=int(h[:8],16)%n_features; sign=+1 if int(h[8:16],16)%2==0 else -1
threshold_policy: max recall at FPR <= 0.50% on combined benign pool (tt val negatives + bipia_benign_tasks + viseca_pack)

scoring.note: score = max(whole text, sliding token windows); defeats dilution of short embedded attacks in benign product text
